response.sql: SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(f.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS record_fraction FROM scanfeatures AS f INNER JOIN sites AS s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The total record count across all groups is the number of joined records with traitcount > 489, i.e. the sum of the group counts after filtering, not the count before the filter.
The fraction is computed with decimal (non-integer) division and left unrounded.
Ties in the fraction have no specified tiebreaker, so their order is arbitrary.
